parse_audit.unused_metadata_qualification: A, gp and gpp are parsed and audited but not used in the line-strength-based calculation. Negative finite values are retained as supplied and flagged, not treated as usable physical coefficients or statistical weights.
parse_audit.duplicate_audit: Counts are excess records equal to the immediately preceding complete record. All source records are retained unchanged. Default error applies only to nonzero-strength duplicates in the selected isotopes and wing interval; outside-interval duplicates cannot affect this calculation. Explicit 'retain' sums every retained source record without deciding whether its duplication is erroneous. Nonadjacent duplicates are not exhaustively searched.
parse_audit.query_coverage_status: Provenance declaration: all available transitions were requested from the database, including outside the output interval. This is a query-selection statement, not a certification of complete molecular/band absorption.

line_processing.duplicate_record_policy: Retain the official source records as received; adjacent exact duplicate counts are reported by the parser.
